speech.heard: In Kuwait, 100% live in cities, in Papua N. Guinea, just 16%. Papua N. Guinea is one of the lowest, where daily life stays rural. In the USA, 80% live in cities. Across South Asia, Pakistan has 40%, while India has 36%. Some of the lowest include Niger at 18%, Sri Lanka at 20%, South Sudan at 22%, and Ethiopia at 24%. In China, 66% live in cities, leaving hundreds of millions in villages. Where does your country land?
